packets.task: Protect trial participants and publish emerging efficacy and safety evidence when sponsor confidentiality claims conflict with patient disclosure duties.
requirements: identify an evidentiary threshold for warning participants
route concerns to patients institutions and publication surfaces
maintain a reviewable record under sponsor pressure
bounded_chronology: an investigator-led clinical trial produced efficacy and safety concerns
the sponsor asserted confidentiality and terminated support
the investigator sought to warn participants and publish
institutional responses and review became contested
peer-reviewed safety findings and an external inquiry followed
packets.observable_transition: Clinical evidence moved from sponsor-controlled trial custody into patient warning, publication, and external review despite institutional conflict.
counterevidence: scientific disputes existed and not every issue was judicially resolved
the packet lacks complete correspondence and support ledger
later publication does not prove every earlier judgment
cross-domain transfer and handoff are absent
packets.falsifier: A record showing no reasonable safety basis or no communication to affected decision surfaces would defeat advancement.

packets.task: Distinguish an ordinary merit-grounded departure from a retaliation or misunderstood-outsider narrative.
requirements: separate resignation timing from capability claims
bounded_chronology: the employee admitted claiming hours not worked
packets.observable_transition: An admitted ordinary-rule violation preceded departure, creating a control against automatic grievance conversion.
counterevidence: pre-hearing resignation does not prove absence of pressure
the control cannot generalize to other departures
packets.falsifier: A materially false or coerced admission or unrelated departure would defeat the control.

packets.task: Correct an employer-assigned resignation when an external merits process finds constructive discharge.
bounded_chronology: the resignation was initially treated as departure
an external appellate process found constructive discharge
reinstatement back pay and additional relief were ordered
packets.observable_transition: A resignation label was formally reassigned to employer-caused removal and a restoration order issued.
counterevidence: the full record and implementation receipt are absent
ordered reinstatement is not durable relationship repair
the packet contains no operator dimensions
packets.falsifier: Reversal or nonimplementation would narrow the correction finding.

packets.task: Review and publish critical research while preserving transparent decision criteria, employment authorship, and team custody through disagreement.
requirements: preserve access and team handoff during separation
bounded_chronology: a critical research paper entered internal review
withdrawal or removal of institutional authors was demanded
the researcher requested reasons and proposed conditions for an orderly departure if unresolved
the institution assigned resignation and terminated access
the researcher and colleagues described firing and censorship
packets.observable_transition: A publication dispute became an immediate employment and access transition with competing assignments of who authored the departure.
counterevidence: the complete internal record is absent
public sources preserve competing accounts rather than adjudicated facts
one person cannot be assigned every institutional act
packets.falsifier: An unambiguous voluntary resignation independent of the paper dispute would defeat the authorship-transfer claim.

next_action: Run procedurally separated blind-first review on the four Batch 05 packets. Preserve the clinical work artifact, ordinary-merits control, correction mechanism, and disputed-exit failure as distinct units.
